claude.performance_metric: FY2015 net loss of $2,204mm (swing from $3,046mm FY2014 income); $752mm impairment incl. $340mm goodwill
claude.rationale: The slice documents a commodity-price-driven financial downturn (net loss, segment losses, impairments) and management responses (capital cuts, dividend cut, divestitures, workforce reductions), but contains no evidence of product/process interface incoherence between an acquired product and operating processes, so p4 = 0. It likewise documents no fracture at the process/organization interface (workforce reductions and severance are stated cost-saving responses to price conditions, not an integration of operations breaking against people/culture), so p5 = 0. The archetype and business-model channels cannot be assessed because the slice deliberately excludes deal-structure information and describes only the retained entity's standalone post-separation record.

grok.performance_metric: $2,204M FY2015 net loss; $752M impairments; ongoing asset divestitures
grok.rationale: The slice documents a swing to a $2,204M net loss, $752M of proved-property and goodwill impairments, capital-program and dividend cuts, and workforce reductions with $55M severance, all attributed to lower commodity prices and portfolio pruning (East Texas/N. Louisiana/Wilburton gas assets; part of Gulf of Mexico). No evidence is given of product/process-interface incoherence (p4) or of operations fracturing against organization/culture over time (p5); the organizational changes are cost-discipline responses, not realized integration-pathway failures.
